sentences.en: Our walk was spoiled by the wind and the rain.
sentences.zh: 风和雨破坏了我们的散步。

sentences.en: Wash the chicory and remove the leaves which may spoil.
sentences.zh: 清洗菊苣并去除可能变质的叶子。

sentences.en: The festive mood was slightly spoiled by terrorist bombs.
sentences.zh: 恐怖袭击炸弹稍微破坏了节日的气氛。

mnemonic: 联想记忆：破坏（spoil）土地（soil），损人利己
